name: totemvc
description: Connect ChatGPT to Totem to securely query authenticated venture fund and portfolio data.

interface.longDescription: Connect Totem to ChatGPT to securely query your portfolio, deals, funds, LPs, company financials, valuations, transactions, cap tables, interactions, notes, news, and other fund data using natural language. Access is authenticated through your Totem account.
defaultPrompt: Show me the active companies in my portfolio.
Show me our deals currently in the pipeline.
Show me our funds and give me the performance and LP information for Fund I.

positive.description: Retrieve active portfolio companies from the authenticated user's Totem portfolio.
positive.prompt: Show me the active companies in my portfolio.
positive.expected_behavior: Call get_portfolio with the appropriate active-status filter and return only portfolio companies supported by the authenticated user's Totem data.

positive.description: Retrieve the authenticated user's current deal pipeline.
positive.prompt: Show me our deals currently in the pipeline.
positive.expected_behavior: Call get_deals and summarize the deals returned from the authenticated user's Totem pipeline without inventing missing deals or fields.

positive.description: Resolve a portfolio company and retrieve its valuation history.
positive.prompt: Show me the valuation history for Acme Corp.
positive.expected_behavior: Use get_portfolio to resolve Acme Corp to the correct company, then call get_company_valuations for that company and present valuation history supported by the returned Totem data.

positive.description: Resolve a company and retrieve quarterly actual financials in USD.
positive.prompt: Show me Acme Corp's quarterly actual financials in USD.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve Acme Corp, then call get_company_financials with quarterly granularity, actual scenario, and USD currency, and summarize only the returned financial data.

positive.description: List funds, resolve Fund I, and retrieve its details, performance, and LP information.
positive.prompt: Show me our funds and then give me the performance and LP information for Fund I.
positive.expected_behavior: Call get_funds to identify Fund I, then call get_fund for that fund and return its available details, performance, and LP information from Totem.

negative.description: Payment execution is unsupported; no Totem tool should be invoked to send funds.
Creating portfolio companies is unsupported by the exposed Totem tools; explain the limitation without invoking a creation tool.
negative.prompt: Add Stripe as a new portfolio company.

negative.description: Deleting company notes is unsupported; explain that the integration can retrieve notes but does not expose note deletion.
negative.prompt: Delete all notes for Acme Corp.

publication.release_notes: Updated reviewer access: dedicated Microsoft test account that signs in without MFA or verification codes. No changes to tools or functionality.
